blocks.tamil_translation: do not act upon it! (For example, the rulings about Tayammum) it is better than praying a thousand rak'ahs of Nafl.” Hazrat Abu Dharr (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said this to him.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ: مَنْ جَاءَ مَسْجِدِي هذَا لَمْ يَأْتِهِ إِلَّا لِخَيْرٍ يَتَعَلَّمُهُ أَوْ يُعَلِّمُهُ فَهُوَ بِمَنْزِلَةِ الْمُجَاهِدِ فِي سَبِيلِ اللهِ وَمَنْ جَاءَ لِغَيْرِذَلِكَ فَهُوَ بِمَنْزِلَةِ الرَّجُلِ يَنْظُرُ إِلَي مَتَاعِ غَيْرِهِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابن ماجه باب فضل العلماء ...رقم:٢٢٧
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) has narrated that he heard Rasulullah ﷺ say, “Whoever comes to this masjid of mine (Masjid an-Nabawi) only to learn or to teach good things, he is (in reward) at the rank of one who does Jihad in the path of Allah. Whoever comes for any other purpose besides this is like one who looks at the belongings of others.” (It is clear that looking at the belongings of others brings oneself no benefit at all.)

blocks.text: Explanation:- The virtues mentioned in the hadith apply to all masjids, because all masjids are subordinate to Masjid an-Nabawi. (Injah al-Hajah)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ يَقُولُ: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا الْقَاسِمِ ﷺ يَقُولُ: خَيْرُكُمْ أَحَاسِنُكُمْ أَخْلَاقاً إِذَا فَقُهُوا.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابن حبان واسناده صحيح علي شرط مسلم:١ /٢٩٤
blocks.tamil_translation: “Whoever has good character along with knowledge of the Deen, he is the best among you”

blocks.text: Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that he heard Abul Qasim (the Prophet ﷺ) say this.
1 This is a name of the Prophet ﷺ.
